entries.content: exec.Command with cmd.Stdin/Stdout/Stderr = os.Stdin/Stdout/Stderr is the correct Go pattern for spawning terminal subprocesses (tmux attach) that need full terminal control without PTY libraries. tmux handles its own terminal setup over the passed-through fds. Must clear TMUX env var from child environment to prevent nesting issues.

subprocess.Run uses piped CombinedOutput — incompatible with any command needing terminal control (tmux attach, ssh, vim, etc.). For terminal-attached commands, use exec.Command directly with fd passthrough.

Kill sentinel files must survive session destruction — tmux session variables (setenv) are destroyed with the session, so they can't be used for post-session-death signaling. Use filesystem-based sentinels instead.
